name: The Chase
source:
The Chase is a very short visual novel. Join Kelsey as she attempts to wrest her skirt back from a conniving feline hell bent on eating her tuna soaked garment. Use her light and dark powers to try to stop him!

[From [url=https://edmango.itch.io/the-chase]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《追逐战》是一部超短篇视觉小说。凯尔茜的裙子沾满了金枪鱼汁，结果被一只狡猾的猫咪死死盯上、一心要把整条裙子吞下肚！跟随凯尔茜展开夺裙大战，运用她体内的光暗之力阻止这只馋嘴猫吧！

[摘自[url=https://edmango.itch.io/the-chase]itch.io[/url]]
